instructions.primary_message: This recipe uses Pillsbury strawberry cake mix; if using a different brand please adjust recipe ingredients and cooking times per package instructions.
FOR THE CAKE: Preheat oven to 350°F. Spray a 13-inch by 9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray, then dust with flour.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 spritz nonstick cooking spray
1 ½ tbsp all-purpose flour

instructions.primary_message: Place cake mix, eggs, water, and oil in a medium bowl. Using a hand-held mixer, blend on medium for 2 minutes, scraping down the sides of the bowl as needed.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (15.25 oz) box strawberry cake mix
½ cup neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: Pour batter into the baking dish and spread out evenly. Place dish in the preheated oven and bake until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out with only a few crumbs attached, 34-38 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool completely, 1 hour.
FOR THE FROSTING: Meanwhile, cut cream cheese and butter into small pieces. Place both in a medium bowl and set aside to soften, 5-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (8 oz) block cream cheese
½ cup butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: When the cream cheese and butter are soft, beat with a hand mixer until combined, 2-3 minutes. Sift powdered sugar, then add to the bowl along with vanilla and salt; continue to beat on low until frosting is combined, 2-3 minutes more. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup powdered sugar
1 tsp vanilla extract
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: TO ASSEMBLE AND DECORATE THE WANDS: Once the cake has cooled, remove from baking dish. Using your hands, crumble the cake into a clean large bowl, breaking it up into fine crumbs.
Add frosting to the bowl with the cake crumbs. Using a hand mixer, mix until a rough dough forms (it should hold together when pressed between your fingers).
Line a large baking sheet pan with parchment paper.

To make cake stars, press a rounded tablespoon of batter to a 2-inch star-shaped mold. Arrange stars on the baking sheet, then insert lollipop sticks into the bottom of each star to create the cake pops. Place baking sheet in freezer to chill until firm and cold to the touch, 10-15 minutes.

Meanwhile, remove lid and safety seal from chocolate candy melt containers. Working one at a time, place each container in the microwave and heat on 50% power or defrost setting for 1 minute. Stir, then repeat heating at 50% power for 30-second intervals, until smooth and completely melted. (If you are using candy melting wafers, place wafers in a microwave safe bowl and heat as directed.) Divide sprinkles between plates (separating them by color).
instructions.secondary_message:
14 oz melting white chocolate candy wafers
14 oz melting pink chocolate candy wafers
¼ cup rainbow sprinkles
¼ cup candy sprinkles

instructions.primary_message: Remove cake pops from freezer. Working one at a time, dip half of the cake pops in white candy melt, then press the face of the star gently into sprinkles of choice to adhere. Return cake pops to the baking sheet, then repeat with remaining cake pops and pink candy melt. Allow to set completely, about 5 minutes.
Arrange on serving platter and enjoy!
